title: Venue
body: Both the ceremony and reception will take place at The Broadview Hotel in the Lincoln Hall and Terrace (2nd floor). No additional travel required, everything will happen in the same building.
Guests may begin arriving at 5:00 PM, with the ceremony beginning promptly at 5:30 PM. Cocktail hour, dinner, and dancing will follow into the evening.

The venue is located at 106 Broadview Ave, Toronto, at the corner of Queen St E and Broadview Ave. It is easily accessible by car service and public transit. A Green P parking lot is located directly across the street for those driving.

title: Dress Code
body: The dress code is black and white formal.
Anything you would typically wear to a wedding — just within those colors.

title: Plus-Ones & Children
body: Due to limited space, we are only able to accommodate guests who are formally invited on the invitation.
And while we love your little ones, we’ve chosen to keep our wedding celebration reserved for adult guests. We truly appreciate your understanding and look forward to celebrating together.

title: RSVP Deadline
body: Kindly respond by Thursday, April 16, 2026 so we can finalize arrangements.

title: Changes to Your RSVP
body: If your plans change after you’ve submitted your RSVP, please contact us directly and we’ll take care of it.
